description: This file contains implementation code for adding custom code to run at the end of a shader's main function, including functions to detect return statements and wrap the main function accordingly.

classes.name: ContainsReturnTraverser
classes.description: A traverser class to detect if a shader contains a return statement.

methods.name: ContainsReturn
methods.description: Checks if a given node contains a return statement.

methods.name: WrapMainAndAppend
methods.description: Replaces the main() function with main0() and appends code to run at the end.

methods.name: RunAtTheEndOfShader
methods.description: Main function to add code to run at the end of the shader's main function, handling cases with or without return statements.
